title: Effective fpqc descent for morphisms with quasi-affine quasi-compact opens
statement: Let $p:A\to B$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] such that $\{p\}$ is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Let $V\to A$ be a morphism of schemes with the following property: for every affine open $U\subseteq A$, every quasi-compact open subscheme $K\subseteq V\times_A U$ has quasi-affine induced morphism $K\to U$ [def-nagata-quasi-affine-morphism]. Suppose $V$ is equipped with a descent datum over $A/B$ [def-pd-descent-datum], given by an isomorphism on $A\times_BA$ satisfying the cocycle on $A\times_BA\times_BA$. Then the datum is effective: there exist a $B$-scheme $V_0$ and an isomorphism $V_0\times_BA\xrightarrow{\sim}V$ over $A$ inducing the given descent datum. No quasi-compactness or local finite-presentation hypothesis on $V\to A$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0APK, lemma-ind-quasi-affine, specialized to a singleton fpqc covering

proof.text: Apply affine-base gluing [lem-galois-fpqc-effectivity-affine-base-gluing] to the ind-quasi-affine property, whose pullback stability is [lem-a1-ind-quasi-affine-permanence]. Over an affine base choose the affine flat surjective singleton refinement [lem-galois-fpqc-singleton-affine-refinement]. Pull back the datum by [lem-galois-fpqc-canonical-pullback-datum]; permanence preserves the property. Effectivity for that affine refinement implies the original effectivity by [lem-galois-fpqc-refinement-reflects-effectivity]. Thus it suffices to handle a flat surjection between affines. This singleton route needs no finite-coproduct permanence of the property.

source.place: Tag 0APK, lemma-ind-quasi-affine, specialized to a singleton fpqc covering

proof.text: Identify the affine cover and base with spectra of their rings of global sections. Naturality of the affine identifications conjugates p to Spec(p.appTop). Transport the datum by composing test points with the inverse cover isomorphism; its three laws are exactly those of the original datum [def-pd-descent-datum]. Transport the effective pullback square and invariant projection back by the same isomorphisms. By [lem-a1-ind-quasi-affine-permanence], V is quasi-separated and all its quasi-compact opens are quasi-affine. The flat surjection of affines is affine, hence quasi-compact and a singleton fpqc covering.

source.place: Tag 0APK, lemma-ind-quasi-affine, specialized to a singleton fpqc covering

proof.text: At each v choose W contained in E by [lem-a1-fpqc-invariant-intersection-neighbourhoods], with E an invariant nonempty intersection of compact opens. Index the family by its members and rewrite the intersection as universal membership. The open invariance equality makes D restrict to W. Apply [lem-a1-invariant-open-affinization-equivariance]: it supplies an affine model Z=Spec Gamma(E), a datum F on Z, and a canonical open immersion j:W→Z over the cover; its transport equation intertwines the restricted datum with F. Apply [lem-galois-affine-flat-descent-effective] directly to F. Its effectivity therefore need not be obtained from a separately chosen section-ring datum.

source.place: Tag 0APK, lemma-ind-quasi-affine, specialized to a singleton fpqc covering

proof.text: Write the effective affine model as Z→Z0. Equivariance makes J=j(W) invariant under F: lift every point of J through j, transport, and use the intertwining equation. On Z×_{Z0}Z the pullback universal property characterizes the second projection as transport of the first. Restricting to its inverse image of J proves one inclusion of the two inverse-image opens; exchanging the projections proves the other. Z→Z0 is fpqc by [lem-galois-fpqc-covering-base-change]. By [lem-weil-pbc-open-subscheme-fpqc-descent], J is the inverse image of an open O in Z0. The lift W→O and j form a pullback square of open immersions; pasting with the model square gives W=O×_S X. Cancel the open inclusion O→Z0 in the transport equation: equivariance and invariance of the model projection show that W→O is invariant. This proves effectivity on W, including W empty.

source.place: Tag 0APK, lemma-ind-quasi-affine, specialized to a singleton fpqc covering

proof.text: Choose such a W for each point v. They form an open cover, and their restricted data have transport compatibility with D by definition. Apply [lem-pd-effective-invariant-open-cover] to their effective models. For empty V this is the empty indexed cover. The coordinate changes and reductions above give the original singleton-cover result with no quasi-compactness or finite-presentation assumption on V.

The fpqc cover of the descended affine model is a base change of the original cover.
Invariant open J descends inside the already effective scheme Z; it does not assert effectivity of V.
Generic gluing of effective invariant open data, after constructing such an open around every point.
Finite coproducts and their open components in the reduction lemma.
The affine-cover and affine-descent hypotheses for maps between affine schemes.

lean.statement: theorem isEffective_of_indQuasiAffine_fpqc {A B : Scheme.{u}} (p : A ⟶ B) (hp : Presieve.singleton p ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage B) {V : Over A} (hV : ∀ (U : A.Opens), IsAffineOpen U → ∀ (K : (Limits.pullback V.hom U.ι).Opens), IsCompact (K : Set (Limits.pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) V.hom U.ι)) → IsQuasiAffineHom (K.ι ≫ Limits.pullback.snd V.hom U.ι)) (D : Over.DescentDatum p V) : D.IsEffective
